sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普成为该国获得这些联邦补贴建筑贷款的最大受益者之一。

sentences.en: And he immediately launched on making these huge projects with low-interest government-guaranteed loans and keeping the costs so low that he was guaranteed a life of extraordinary wealth.
sentences.zh: 他立即利用政府担保的低息贷款着手建造这些庞大的项目，并将成本控制得如此之低，以至于他注定能过上极其富裕的生活。

sentences.en: So as you're going through all of Fred Trump's documents, at what point does Donald Trump appear?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你们查阅弗雷德·特朗普的所有文件时，唐纳德·特朗普是在什么时候出现的？

sentences.en: Donald Trump starts to show up in his father's business affairs when he's three years old in 1949.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在1949年他三岁时开始出现在他父亲的商业事务中。

sentences.en: So what the documents revealed to us was that when Donald Trump was three years old, he was actually Fred Trump's landlord.
sentences.zh: 文件向我们揭示的是，当唐纳德·特朗普三岁时，他实际上是弗雷德·特朗普的房东。

sentences.en: Fred Trump gives his children the land under these massive apartment projects that he's built and then begins paying them rent.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普将他建造的大型公寓项目底下的土地过户给他的孩子们，然后开始向他们支付租金。

sentences.en: And as we begin tracking those payments, we see that those payments made Donald Trump the equivalent of a millionaire in today's dollars by age nine.
sentences.zh: 随着我们开始追踪这些付款，我们发现这些付款让唐纳德·特朗普在9岁时就相当于按今天的美元计算的百万富翁。

sentences.en: And then in the early 1960s, Fred Trump was beginning to actually transfer buildings, actual buildings, to his kids.
sentences.zh: 然后在20世纪60年代初，弗雷德·特朗普开始真正将建筑物、真正的建筑物过户给他的孩子们。

sentences.en: He runs them still.
sentences.zh: 他依然在经营它们。

sentences.en: He does all the labor.
sentences.zh: 他承包了所有的体力活。

sentences.en: But on paper, his children are the owners and the profits for those buildings start going to them.
sentences.zh: 但在纸面上，他的孩子们才是所有者，那些建筑的利润开始归他们所有。

sentences.en: So Donald Trump, at age 17, became an owner of a 52-unit apartment building in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 因此，唐纳德·特朗普在17岁时，就成为了布鲁克林一栋52个单元公寓楼的所有者。

sentences.en: And things just keep coming at him.
sentences.zh: 各种事情接踵而至。

sentences.en: 1968, he graduates from college and he lands right into a cushy job at his father's company with a salary.
sentences.zh: 1968年，他大学毕业，顺利进入他父亲的公司，拿着优厚的薪水。

sentences.en: Fred Trump found a way to make Donald Trump one of his bankers.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普想方设法让唐纳德·特朗普成为他的金融顾问之一。

sentences.en: He gets consulting fees for doing things for his father.
sentences.zh: 他因为帮父亲做事而获得咨询费。

sentences.en: He leased a car for him.
sentences.zh: 他为他租了一辆车。

sentences.en: He built his first offices in Manhattan for him.
sentences.zh: 他为他在曼哈顿建造了他的第一间办公室。

sentences.en: He also found ways to give him the laundry revenue from his buildings.
sentences.zh: 他还想方设法把旗下建筑的洗衣房收入交给他。

sentences.en: And then in 1976, you see this article in the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 然后，在1976年，你看到了《纽约时报》上的这篇文章。

sentences.en: Let me grab it.
sentences.zh: 让我找找看。

sentences.en: And I'll just read you the lead.
sentences.zh: 我给你们念一下导语。

sentences.en: It says, He is tall, lean, and blonde, with dazzling white teeth.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：他身材高大、精瘦、金发碧眼，有着耀眼的白牙。

sentences.en: He looks ever so much like Robert Redford.
sentences.zh: 他看起来极其像罗伯特·雷德福。

sentences.en: He rides around town in a chauffeured silver Cadillac.
sentences.zh: 他坐着配有司机的银色凯迪拉克满城兜风。

sentences.en: He dates slinky fashion models, belongs to the most elegant clubs.
sentences.zh: 他与曼妙的时尚模特约会，出入最优雅的俱乐部。

sentences.en: And at only 30 years of age, estimates that he is worth more than $200 million.
sentences.zh: 年仅30岁，他估计自己的身家就超过了2亿美元。

sentences.en: He took the New York Times reporter on a tour of what he was describing as his empire.
sentences.zh: 他带着《纽约时报》的记者参观了他所描述的自己的商业帝国。

sentences.en: Showing this reporter all the things he's done, all the things he's built, all of his jobs.
sentences.zh: 向记者展示他所做的一切，他建造的一切，他的所有工作。

sentences.en: This building, and this building, and this building.
sentences.zh: 这栋楼，还有这栋楼，以及这栋楼。

sentences.en: What we now know from looking at these records is that Donald Trump didn't own any of that.
sentences.zh: 我们现在通过查看这些记录得知，唐纳德·特朗普其实并不拥有其中任何东西。

sentences.en: Donald Trump hadn't been involved in the building of any of that.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普根本没有参与其中任何建筑的建造。

sentences.en: It's accurate, probably, that he was dating slinky fashion models, but we've come to learn.
sentences.zh: 他当时确实在和曼妙的时尚模特约会，这可能是真的，但我们后来了解到。

sentences.en: It was all his father's empire, his father's success.
sentences.zh: 这一切其实都是他父亲的帝国，他父亲的成功。

sentences.en: And he was just appropriating all of that as his own to build his own myth.
sentences.zh: 而他只是把这一切据为己有，用来构建自己的神话。

sentences.en: This is sort of like the first instance where you just see the lie begins.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是你看到谎言开始的最初例证。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Trump, for joining us this morning.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，特朗普先生，今天早上能来参加我们的节目。

sentences.en: Hiya, Dan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，丹。

sentences.en: I have heard that you are worth something like $3 billion.
sentences.zh: 我听说你的身家大约有30亿美元。

sentences.en: It seemed like in the 1980s, every time you turned on the TV...
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，似乎每当你打开电视……

sentences.en: Well, I've always said, you know, money isn't a totally essential ingredient, but it does make it easier.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一直都说，你知道，钱虽然不是绝对不可或缺的要素，但它确实能让事情变得更容易。

sentences.en: He was there.
sentences.zh: 他就在那里。

sentences.en: He's young, he has Robert Redford good looks, and he's rich.
sentences.zh: 他很年轻，有着罗伯特·雷德福般的长相，而且他很有钱。

sentences.en: And he was telling you how successful he was.
sentences.zh: 他在向你诉说着自己是多么的成功。

sentences.en: To buy everything and then we're passionate.
sentences.zh: 买下一切，然后我们充满激情。

sentences.en: I bet you would.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你确实会。

sentences.en: It's at that point in time when Donald Trump begins to realize, I can say almost anything to reporters.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，唐纳德·特朗普开始意识到，我对记者几乎什么都可以说。

sentences.en: Are you smarter than most people who would call themselves entrepreneurs?
sentences.zh: 你比大多数自称为企业家的人更聪明吗？

sentences.en: And it will come to a newer benefit to my image and my reputation, and I can make money off of that reputation.
sentences.zh: 这会对我的形象和声誉带来新的好处，我可以利用这种声誉赚钱。

sentences.en: Well, that's an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I don't know if anyone's ever asked me the question, am I smarter than other people?
sentences.zh: 我不知道有没有人问过我这个问题：我比其他人更聪明吗？

sentences.en: I think that...
sentences.zh: 我认为……

sentences.en: He starts buying casinos, yachts from princes.
sentences.zh: 他开始收购赌场，向王子们购买游艇。

sentences.en: He buys the Plaza Hotel.
sentences.zh: 他买下了广场酒店。

sentences.en: I just bought the Plaza Hotel in New York and my business, real estate, that's the ultimate crown jewel.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚买下了纽约的广场酒店，我的业务——房地产，那才是终极的皇冠明珠。

sentences.en: He's able to convince bankers to give him these tremendously outsized loans based just on the image, the myth that he's built for himself already.
sentences.zh: 他仅凭自己已经构建的形象和神话，就能说服银行家给他提供这些数额巨大的惊人贷款。

sentences.en: And one thing that we found that I don't think anybody ever knew before is that his father goes along with the ride on some of that.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一件事是，我认为以前没有人知道，他的父亲在其中某些事情上也推波助澜。

sentences.en: They had this particularly intimate father-son relationship.
sentences.zh: 他们有着这种格外亲密的父子关系。

sentences.en: They talked to each other constantly, and they each shared this view of the world, that the world was this zero-sum game.
sentences.zh: 他们不断地交流，并且都共享着这样一种世界观：世界是一场零和博弈。

sentences.en: The idea that your worth in a family matters based on how much money you're making.
sentences.zh: 这种观念认为，你在家庭中的价值取决于你赚了多少钱。

sentences.en: And you were either a killer or you were killed.
sentences.zh: 要么你是个强者，要么你就会被淘汰。

sentences.en: And there was sort of nothing in between.
sentences.zh: 基本上没有中间地带。

sentences.en: So, one of the revelations that we came across in the documents was how Fred and Donald Trump coordinated stock purchases together.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在文件中发现的一个内幕是，弗雷德和唐纳德·特朗普是如何协同购买股票的。

sentences.en: For example, in the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 例如，在20世纪80年代末。

sentences.en: New York tycoon Donald Trump wants control of the nation's largest airline.
sentences.zh: 纽约大亨唐纳德·特朗普想要获得全美最大航空公司的控制权。

sentences.en: Donald Trump would leak to the financial press that he was taking a position in American Airlines.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普会向财经媒体透露他正在建仓美国航空公司。

sentences.en: He doesn't have the financial wherewithal to take over those corporations.
sentences.zh: 他并没有足够的财力来接管这些公司。

sentences.en: But his father, we can see in his tax returns, buys stock in American Airlines.
sentences.zh: 但我们从他的纳税申报表中可以看出，他的父亲购买了美国航空公司的股票。

sentences.en: Then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: American Airlines was the most active stock on the big board yesterday, pushing all transportation issues sharply higher.
sentences.zh: 美国航空公司昨天成为大盘中交易最活跃的股票，带动所有交通运输板块大幅走高。

sentences.en: The stock goes way up.
sentences.zh: 股票大涨。

sentences.en: And his father tries to sell before it goes down.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲试图在股票下跌前抛售。

sentences.en: He doesn't make it.
sentences.zh: 他没赶上。

sentences.en: We saw this pattern in multiple instances.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个案例中都看到了这种模式。

sentences.en: In another case, Donald made a public comment that he was going to take over Time, Inc., the magazine and publishing company.
sentences.zh: 在另一个案例中，唐纳德公开评论说他将接管杂志和出版公司时代公司。

sentences.en: His father did buy stock right before Donald made those comments.
sentences.zh: 就在唐纳德发表这些评论之前，他父亲确实买入了股票。

sentences.en: A week later, sold it, and he wound up making $40,000 just on his son's hot air, basically.
sentences.zh: 一周后卖出，基本上仅仅靠他儿子的空头言论就净赚了4万美元。

sentences.en: It was a very clear manifestation of these two guys executing financial strategies together.
sentences.zh: 这非常清晰地展现了这两个家伙共同执行财务策略的过程。

sentences.en: It was more than just a father-son relationship.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一种父子关系。

sentences.en: They were trying to achieve something together in terms of elevating the idea of Donald Trump as self-made billionaire.
sentences.zh: 他们试图在共同实现一个目标，即提升唐纳德·特朗普作为白手起家的亿万富翁的形象。

sentences.en: This goes on for years.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了多年。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the author of this book right here, Trump, The Art of the Deal, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，请欢迎这本书的作者，也就是《特朗普：交易的艺术》的作者，唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: In 1987, Donald Trump published this book, The Art of the Deal.
sentences.zh: 1987年，唐纳德·特朗普出版了这本书《交易的艺术》。

sentences.en: Where do you learn The Art of the Deal?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里学习交易的艺术？

sentences.en: I mean, what point were you working with your father and you knew that there were bigger things for you?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在什么时候与父亲共事，并知道自己注定要成就大事？

sentences.en: Well, I really think you have it or you don't have it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的认为这要么是天生具备的，要么就是没有。

sentences.en: The premise of the book was that he only made good deals, that he could tell the world how to make good deals and get rich on their own.
sentences.zh: 这本书的前提是，他只做好的交易，他可以告诉世界如何做好的交易并靠自己发财。

sentences.en: And you have to go and be driven and, you know, do all the different things that we all sort of know about and the things I discuss in the book.
sentences.zh: 你必须去努力拼搏，你知道的，去做我们大家都知道的各种事情，以及我在书中讨论的事情。

sentences.en: But by 1990, all of his bets had gone bad.
sentences.zh: 但到了1990年，他所有的押注都失败了。

sentences.en: He was already getting deep into the hole that would lead to his darkest moment.
sentences.zh: 他已经越陷越深，这将把他带向他至暗的时刻。

sentences.en: Casinos are failing.
sentences.zh: 赌场在亏损。

sentences.en: Businesses are failing.
sentences.zh: 企业在倒闭。

sentences.en: He was just buried in debt.
sentences.zh: 他被债务压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: He is going through a very rough divorce with Ivana Trump.
sentences.zh: 他正在经历与伊凡娜·特朗普非常艰难的离婚。

sentences.en: What we found and what people haven't known before is the degree to which his father helped him out of that hole.
sentences.zh: 我们发现以及人们此前所不知道的是，他父亲在多大程度上帮他走出了那个泥潭。

sentences.en: It was loan after loan after loan.
sentences.zh: 那是一笔又一笔又一笔的贷款。

sentences.en: He owed his father at that point in time somewhere between 15 and 25 million dollars that he never talked about and that he wasn't paying back.
sentences.zh: 当时他欠他父亲大约1500万到2500万美元，这件事他从未提起过，也没有偿还。

sentences.en: In the financial records that we've obtained, we can see that the flow of money from Fred Trump to Donald Trump increased at moments when Donald Trump was in his highest duress.
sentences.zh: 在我们获取的财务记录中，我们可以看到，当唐纳德·特朗普处于最大压力时刻时，从弗雷德·特朗普流向唐纳德·特朗普的资金反而增加了。

sentences.en: He can't make his loan payments.
sentences.zh: 他还不起贷款了。

sentences.en: People are talking about foreclosing, taking away everything.
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论法拍，要夺走他的一切。

sentences.en: He gets down at one point to just having a couple of million dollars in the bank, and he's burning through more than that every month.
sentences.zh: 有一次他的银行账户里只剩下几百万美元，而他每月的消耗却远超这个数字。

sentences.en: So in the course of our reporting, we've learned that in 1990, in this just really dark period in Donald Trump's life,
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们的报道过程中，我们了解到在1990年，在唐纳德·特朗普人生的这段至暗时期，

sentences.en: he makes an aggressive play to get more control of his father's wealth.
sentences.zh: 他采取了激进的行动，试图获得对其父亲财富的更多控制权。

sentences.en: It's one of the most remarkable discoveries we made along the way.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在调查过程中发现的最令人瞩目的事情之一。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So what was this remarkable discovery you made in your investigation?
sentences.zh: 那么，你在调查中发现了什么了不起的内幕？

sentences.en: So at that crucial point in his life, 1990, we found Donald Trump crafts, in essence, a new will for his father.
sentences.zh: 所以在他人生的这个关键节点，即1990年，我们发现唐纳德·特朗普实质上为其父亲草拟了一份新遗嘱。

sentences.en: It amends the will that's there.
sentences.zh: 它修改了现有的遗嘱。

sentences.en: And then he sends lawyers to his father's house to have him sign it.
sentences.zh: 然后他派律师去他父亲家里让他签字。

sentences.en: His father had no idea this was coming and flipped out.
sentences.zh: 他父亲对此一无所知，气急败坏。

sentences.en: And according to the sworn testimony of his relatives, as he read it,
sentences.zh: 根据他亲属的宣誓证词，当他阅读这份文件时，

sentences.en: he began to realize that what this document would do is that it would give Donald Trump extraordinary control over his estate upon his death.
sentences.zh: 他开始意识到这份文件的作用是，让唐纳德·特朗普在他去世后对其遗产拥有非同寻常的控制权。

sentences.en: His father was 84 years old, but still an incredibly savvy man and looked at this and thought,
sentences.zh: 他父亲当时84岁，但仍然是一个极其精明的人，看到这个便想，

sentences.en: this is my son who is in incredible trouble right now trying to get control of the empire that I built.
sentences.zh: 这就是我那个现在陷入极度麻烦、妄图夺取我建立的商业帝国的儿子。

sentences.en: You know, that was a step too far for Fred Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这对弗雷德·特朗普来说太过分了。

sentences.en: This means that my son's creditors could come after my wealth, my empire, and he shuts the whole thing down.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我儿子的债权人可以冲着我的财富、我的帝国来，于是他全盘叫停。

sentences.en: He calls his daughter, Marianne Trump-Barry,
sentences.zh: 他打电话给他的女儿玛丽安·特朗普-巴里，

sentences.en: has her organize a legal team to come up with a new will that will make sure that Donald Trump doesn't have any more control than any of his siblings and that his business problems can't drain his own empire.
sentences.zh: 让她组织一个法律团队来拟定一份新遗嘱，确保唐纳德·特朗普不会拥有比他任何兄弟姐妹更多的控制权，并且他的商业问题不会拖垮自己的帝国。

sentences.en: That episode, it is this moment, this jolt, it kind of triggers a deeper reckoning within the Trump family.
sentences.zh: 那个插曲，就是这个时刻，这记重击，在特朗普家族内部引发了更深层次的反思。

sentences.en: It forces them to come to grips with two facts.
sentences.zh: 它迫使他们正视两个事实。

sentences.en: One is that Fred Trump is starting to get frail.
sentences.zh: 一是弗雷德·特朗普开始显现老态。

sentences.en: His health is failing.
sentences.zh: 他的健康状况正在恶化。

sentences.en: He's starting to suffer the effects of dementia.
sentences.zh: 他开始遭受痴呆症的影响。

sentences.en: And then the kids start to recognize dad has this enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 然后孩子们开始意识到父亲拥有这笔巨额财富。

sentences.en: He had all these buildings that were worth hundreds of millions of dollars and he had tens of millions of dollars running through his bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 他拥有价值数亿美元的房产，并且他的银行账户里流转着数千万美元的资金。

sentences.en: Like, we just couldn't believe when we started looking through the financial records of his companies how much cash he had.
sentences.zh: 比如，当我们开始查阅他公司的财务记录时，简直不敢相信他竟然有这么多现金。

sentences.en: And what they were recognizing at that moment was that if Fred Trump died, all of that, every penny of that is subject to a 55% estate tax.
sentences.zh: 他们在那个时刻意识到的是，如果弗雷德·特朗普去世，所有这一切，其中的每一分钱都将面临55%的遗产税。

sentences.en: So that means if Fred Trump passed away and was worth a billion dollars, 55% of all of that goes to Uncle Sam.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果弗雷德·特朗普去世时身家十亿美元，其中55%都将归山姆大叔所有。

sentences.en: And so the Trumps come up with a plan, a plan beyond the bounds of the law.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普家族制定了一个计划，一个超越法律边界的计划。

sentences.en: One of the first steps they took was to create something called all-county building supply.
sentences.zh: 他们采取的第一步行动之一是创建了一家名为“全县建筑供应”的公司。

sentences.en: All-county building supply and maintenance.
sentences.zh: 全县建筑供应与维护公司。

sentences.en: So Fred Trump bought an enormous amount of goods and services to keep his buildings going.
sentences.zh: 当时弗雷德·特朗普为了维持其建筑的运营，购买了大量的商品和劳务。

sentences.en: For years, Fred Trump was buying everything he needed for his buildings directly from wholesalers.
sentences.zh: 多年来，弗雷德·特朗普一直直接从批发商那里购买建筑所需的一切物资。

sentences.en: So he needed an air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 所以他需要一台空调。

sentences.en: He'd write a check, get an air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 他就开张支票，买一台空调。

sentences.en: He needed paint supplies.
sentences.zh: 他需要油漆用品。

sentences.en: Go and get paint supplies.
sentences.zh: 去买油漆用品。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, this new company comes along called All-County.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，出现了一家名为“全县”的新公司。

sentences.en: And it starts buying everything.
sentences.zh: 它开始购买所有的东西。

sentences.en: So it will pay $100 for the air conditioner, $300 for the fridge, $100,000 for the boiler.
sentences.zh: 所以它以100美元买空调，300美元买冰箱，10万元买锅炉。

sentences.en: And then they turn around and they bill Fred Trump for the very same items at this marked-up price.
sentences.zh: 然后他们转过头来，以这个加价后的价格向弗雷德·特朗普开具完全相同的物品账单。

sentences.en: And if they paid $150 for the air conditioner, they then bill Fred Trump $250 and they pocket the difference.
sentences.zh: 如果他们以150美元买入空调，他们就会向弗雷德·特朗普收取250美元，并将差价收入囊中。

sentences.en: Same thing with the fridge and stove.
sentences.zh: 冰箱和炉灶也是如此。

sentences.en: So if they buy it for $200, they send an invoice to Fred for $300, All-County pockets the difference.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们以200美元买入，他们就会向弗雷德发送300美元的发票，“全县”公司将差价收入囊中。

sentences.en: It's a kind of a middleman that's doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 这是一种什么都不干的中间商。

sentences.en: This company had no employees.
sentences.zh: 这家公司没有员工。

sentences.en: It was doing no negotiating of its own.
sentences.zh: 它不进行任何自己的谈判。

sentences.en: Literally, it's an invoice padding operation.
sentences.zh: 从字面意义上看，这就是一个虚增发票的操作。

sentences.en: All-County was a company set up with the sole purpose of deceiving the IRS.
sentences.zh: “全县”公司成立的唯一目的就是欺骗美国国税局。

sentences.en: And we've run this scenario past some of the best tax experts in the country.
sentences.zh: 我们将这个方案拿给国内一些顶尖的税务专家看。

sentences.en: And every single one of them says, that's fraud.
sentences.zh: 他们每一个人都说，这就是欺诈。

sentences.en: It's incredible to think about.
sentences.zh: 想想看，这真令人难以置信。

sentences.en: One of the things that really jumped out at us is how effective that process was.
sentences.zh: 真正让我们感到意外的是，这个过程的效率竟然如此之高。

sentences.en: It started out relatively small in 1992, but by 1998, it was generating millions of dollars a year in profits to the Trump children.
sentences.zh: 它在1992年起步时规模还相对较小，但到了1998年，每年为特朗普的孩子们产生数百万美元的利润。

sentences.en: By the time he dies in 1999...
sentences.zh: 直到他于1999年去世...

sentences.en: He goes from being a guy who was sitting on tens of millions of dollars of cash to a guy who has less than $2 million left.
sentences.zh: 他的资产从手握数千万美元现金，缩水到只剩下不到200万美元。

sentences.en: His biggest asset is a $10 million debt that Donald Trump owed him.
sentences.zh: 他最大的资产是唐纳德·特朗普欠他的一笔1000万美元的债务。

sentences.en: And that, in and of itself, is a testament to simply how successful they were at making cash disappear.
sentences.zh: 仅凭这一点，就足以证明他们在让现金蒸发这件事上取得了多大的成功。

sentences.en: But the second part of the scheme was actually maybe the most ingenious.
sentences.zh: 但该计划的第二部分可能才是最巧妙的。

sentences.en: And it involved the biggest tax dodge of all.
sentences.zh: 其中涉及最大的一笔逃税行为。

sentences.en: By the early 1990s, they're basically through All-County and another entity that they set up, getting their father's profits from his empire.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪90年代初，他们基本上通过All-County以及他们设立的另一个实体，获取他们父亲从帝国中获得的利润。

sentences.en: But their father still owns the buildings themselves.
sentences.zh: 但他们的父亲仍然拥有这些建筑物本身。

sentences.en: He owned all these buildings, hundreds of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他拥有所有这些建筑物，价值数亿美元。

sentences.en: Bricks and mortar.
sentences.zh: 实打实的房产。

sentences.en: And they're going to take control of that empire through this particular kind of trust that's called a grat.
sentences.zh: 他们将通过这种被称为“格拉特”的特殊信托来接管这个帝国。

sentences.en: Lots of rich people have truSt.
sentences.zh: 许多有钱人都有信托。

sentences.en: It's kind of a vehicle for transferring wealth from one generation to the next.
sentences.zh: 这是一种将财富从一代传给下一代的工具。

sentences.en: In this case, what the Trumps did is, having put all of these apartment buildings in this trust, they then systematically lowballed the value of each apartment building.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，特朗普家族的做法是，将所有这些公寓楼放入这个信托后，系统性地低估了每栋公寓楼的价值。

sentences.en: They went out and they got an appraiser and the appraisals that came back are just unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 他们找来了一名评估师，而得出的评估结果简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: They had all of these buildings in Fred Trump's empire appraised so that rather than being what they really were, which was 10, 15, 20 million dollar buildings,
sentences.zh: 他们对弗雷德·特朗普帝国中的所有这些建筑物进行了评估，原本价值1000万、1500万、2000万美元的建筑，

sentences.en: instead having them appraised as if they were 1, 2, 3 million dollar buildings.
sentences.zh: 却被评估为好像只值100万、200万、300万美元的建筑。

sentences.en: They find an appraiser who says some of Fred Trump's biggest apartment buildings are absolutely worthless.
sentences.zh: 他们找了一个评估师，声称弗雷德·特朗普最大的一些公寓楼毫无价值。

sentences.en: And they did this over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他们一次又一次、一遍又一遍地这样做。

sentences.en: And then they pushed the limits in other ways as well to reduce the overall value of this tremendously profitable massive empire.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还在其他方面突破极限，以降低这个利润丰厚、庞大帝国的整体价值。

sentences.en: They put a value ultimately on this empire of 40 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们最终给这个帝国估价4000万美元。

sentences.en: What we found in our analysis is that in real life, in market value, it was worth at least 10 times that.
sentences.zh: 我们在分析中发现，在现实生活中，按市场价值计算，它的价值至少是这个数字的10倍。

sentences.en: This is an empire that less than a decade later, the banks would place a value of almost a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在不到十年后，银行对其估值近十亿美元的帝国。

sentences.en: The tax experts that we've interviewed are saying that the way that Trumps took this legal thing and twisted it is, in fact, illegal.
sentences.zh: 我们采访过的税务专家表示，特朗普将这种合法手段进行歪曲的做法实际上是非法的。

sentences.en: You're not allowed to submit bogus appraisals to the IRS.
sentences.zh: 你不能向国税局提交虚假的评估报告。

sentences.en: The appraisals really have to reflect reality.
sentences.zh: 评估必须真正反映现实。

sentences.en: I started off with a very, very small amount of money.
sentences.zh: 我起步时的资金非常非常少。

sentences.en: And by the way, when my father passed away, remember, I have four, I have a total of five in my family.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，在我父亲去世时，记住，我有四个，我家总共有五个孩子。

sentences.en: So we have brothers, sisters, split.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有兄弟姐妹，平分。

sentences.en: And my father didn't leave a great fortune.
sentences.zh: 我父亲并没有留下巨额财富。

sentences.en: It was Brooklyn and Queens real estate.
sentences.zh: 那都是布鲁克林和皇后区的房产。

sentences.en: It's interesting because that estate has, again, fed into this narrative.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为这笔遗产再次迎合了这种说法。

sentences.en: When Donald Trump points to it, he can say, look, my father's estate was only worth, you know, 20, 30 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普提到它时，他可以说，看，我父亲的遗产只值2000万、3000万美元。

sentences.en: But now what they do is they build it up like, oh, he left Donald money.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们把它包装得好像他给唐纳德留下了巨款。

sentences.en: I started off with one million dollars and now I'm worth over 10 billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 我起步时只有一百万美元，现在我的身家超过一百亿美元。

sentences.en: This guy, the 45th president of the United States, he inherited hundreds of millions of dollars from his father and much of it was gotten through fraudulent means.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，美国第四十五任总统，从他父亲那里继承了数亿美元，其中很大一部分是通过欺诈手段获得的.

sentences.en: I mean, that's that's an important chapter in his history that should be set straight and people should know about.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是他历史上的一个重要篇章，应该被拨乱反正，人们应该了解真相。

sentences.en: So now that this investigation has been made public, what could come of these revelations?
sentences.zh: 既然这项调查已经公开，这些披露会带来什么结果呢？

sentences.en: Where all this falls, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这一切将走向何方，我不得而知。

sentences.en: A lot of it has passed statutes of limitations.
sentences.zh: 其中很多已经过了诉讼时效。

sentences.en: Criminal statutes generally limit people's exposure to a criminal charge to five to seven years.
sentences.zh: 刑事诉讼时效通常将人们面临刑事指控的期限限制在五到七年。

sentences.en: All those clocks have long since told.
sentences.zh: 所有这些时钟早已停止走动。

sentences.en: There is still the possibility for the IRS to perhaps penalize the family for what they did, pursue back taxes, issue fines.
sentences.zh: 国税局仍然有可能就他们所做的事情对该家族进行惩罚、追缴税款并开出罚单。

sentences.en: The statute of limitations on that is forever.
sentences.zh: 这方面的诉讼时效是永久的。

sentences.en: So they could come back at any point in time and look at that and impose penalties on them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可以在任何时候回过头来调查此事并对他们施加处罚。

sentences.en: But the IRS in this case is under the management of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，国税局是在特朗普总统的管理之下。

sentences.en: And the likelihood of that seems very remote.
sentences.zh: 这种可能性似乎非常渺茫。

sentences.en: So we, on the one hand, feel like, OK, we have peeled back many,
sentences.zh: 因此，一方面，我们觉得，好吧，我们已经剥开了许多，

sentences.en: many new layers of the onion of the story of Donald Trump and his money simply by taking his father's tax returns and taking all of these other documents that lay bare the financial relationship between Fred and Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 许多关于唐纳德·特朗普及其财富故事的新洋葱皮，仅仅通过获取他父亲的纳税申报表以及所有这些揭示弗雷德与唐纳德·特朗普之间财务关系的文件。

sentences.en: That tells us so much about the first, say, 50-plus years of Donald Trump's life.
sentences.zh: 这让我们对唐纳德·特朗普的前50多年的人生有了深入的了解。

sentences.en: But just imagine how much more we could learn, how many more questions we could ask, how many more layers we could peel back if we could just get our hands on his tax returns.
sentences.zh: 但试想一下，如果我们能拿到他的纳税申报表，我们还能了解多少，还能提出多少问题，还能剥开多少层洋葱皮。

sentences.en: So since the story ran, officials or regulators from both New York State and New York City have been looking into it.
sentences.zh: 因此，自从这篇报道发表以来，纽约州和纽约市的官员或监管机构一直在调查此事。

sentences.en: And they're just trying to figure out at this point if there's any back taxes that could be owed because of the fraud that we uncovered.
sentences.zh: 他们目前正试图弄清楚，由于我们揭露的欺诈行为，是否可能有任何补缴税款。

sentences.en: And then separately, and other things happened since the story ran, and that is that the Democrats will soon control the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，报道发表后还发生了一些其他事情，那就是民主党人即将控制众议院。

sentences.en: And that's going to be really interesting because they are going to have the ability to request Donald Trump's taxes.
sentences.zh: 这将非常有趣，因为他们将有能力索取唐纳德·特朗普的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: And that doesn't mean that they're going to request them and that immediately they're going to be out in public view.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他们一索取，这些资料就会立即公之于众。

sentences.en: There's probably going to be a lot of legal wrangling around that.
sentences.zh: 围绕这一点可能会有很多法律争斗。

sentences.en: I'm sure the president, you know, faced with his taxes being released could potentially mount a court fight.
sentences.zh: 我确信总统在面对其纳税申报表被公开时，很可能会在法庭上发起抗争。

sentences.en: And it's also just, will the Democrats immediately want to do that if they're trying to build bridges and get other things done?
sentences.zh: 这也关乎，如果民主党人正试图修复关系并完成其他事情，他们会立即想要这样做吗？

sentences.en: But if they are released or they are leaked, and we hope it's to us, we're ready to go as a team.
sentences.zh: 但如果它们被公开或泄露，我们希望是泄露给我们，我们团队已经准备好行动了。
